integrity.proof_basis: Exact graph-distance enumeration plus a complete acyclic discrete-Morse certificate at scale 2 and a perfect-matching complement argument at scale 3.
integrity.reproducibility: verify.py is standalone and deterministically reproduces all finite checks from the displayed graph definition.
integrity.source_date_basis: arXiv:2302.14388v1 was first submitted 2023-02-28; journal dates and later revisions were not used for the first-public-date field.

scientific_limitations: The claim determines the homotopy types only for the shortest-path metric on the single graph \(G(8,3)\).
No general formula for other generalized Petersen graphs is asserted.
The literature comparison cannot exclude an uncatalogued source containing the same finite case.
title: Complete graph-metric Vietoris–Rips filtration of the Möbius–Kantor graph
